name: cship
description: Self-hosted, Vercel-like deployment control panel for cPanel

scripts.install:all: npm install --no-audit --no-fund && npm install --prefix server --no-audit --no-fund && npm install --prefix client --no-audit --no-fund
scripts.test: npm --prefix server test && npm --prefix client test
scripts.lint: npm --prefix server run lint && npm --prefix client run lint
